description: A qualitative analysis application you use in conversation with Claude, compatible with QualCoder: create projects, read, search and code your qualitative data, edit the codebook, write memos and export, in project files on this computer.
long_description:
Exegete (formerly qualcoder-mcp) is a qualitative analysis application you use in conversation with Claude, compatible with QualCoder. With Claude, you start projects, bring in documents and transcripts, read them with their codings, search, code them with suggestions you approve, edit the codebook, write memos, and export your codebook, coding and counts. Your projects are folders on this computer in QualCoder's format, so you can work on them in either program, one at a time. QualCoder is free software for qualitative analysis, of the same kind as NVivo, ATLAS.ti and MAXQDA; Exegete is an independent project, not part of QualCoder and not made by its developers.

Every write is preceded by a backup of the project unless the call asks for none. Exegete runs on this computer and adds no telemetry of its own, but what its tools return enters the conversation and is sent to Anthropic like any other chat content: read PRIVACY.md before you use research data (https://github.com/nicotem/exegete/blob/main/PRIVACY.md). Once a week at most, and when you ask, it fetches a small file from its website, which GitHub hosts, to see whether a newer version exists; nothing from your projects is sent, and the setting "Tell me when a new version is out" switches it off.

The settings choose the tool set (with or without creating new projects), the folder where new projects and working copies are kept, and whether Exegete tells you when a new version is out.

toolset.title: Tool set
toolset.description: Type one of three words. lifecycle: every tool, including creating a new project (recommended). full: every tool except creating a project. core: a smaller set for local models. Any other word stops the extension from starting.

projects_folder.title: Folder for projects
projects_folder.description: Where new projects are created and working copies of projects are kept. The default, QualCoder projects in your home folder (~), is outside Documents, which iCloud or OneDrive may sync; it is made when the first project needs it. If you choose another folder, choose one that no sync service keeps. Leaving it empty stops the extension from starting.

update_check.title: Tell me when a new version is out
update_check.description: Exegete fetches a small file from its website, which GitHub hosts, to see whether a newer version exists: once a week at most on its own, and when Claude checks for you. Claude then tells you once. Nothing from your projects is sent; GitHub records your computer's internet address and the time, as any website does. Switch this off and Exegete itself makes no connection.
